# TeleQnA - Telecom LLM Benchmark

10,000 multiple-choice telecom questions across five categories (lexicon, research overview, research publications, standards overview, standards specifications) for assessing LLM telecom knowledge. Dataset is a password-protected zip (password 'teleqnadataset', documented in the repo README) to prevent training-data contamination. Underpins the agentic RAG training row.
